meta_title: Derby Locksmith & Security | Emergency Locksmith Nottingham
meta_description: Derby Locksmith & Security in Nottingham offers 24/7 emergency lockout services, lock repairs, and security solutions. Call now for rapid response.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Response — Locked Out? We're On Our Way
hero_subhead: Stuck outside your home or business? Derby Locksmith arrives within 30 minutes, day or night, to get you back in.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to security upgrades, we handle residential and commercial lock work with speed and professionalism.

services.title: Emergency Lockout
services.desc: Locked out of your home or business? We arrive fast with non-destructive entry techniques. No damage, minimal fuss.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken locks, worn mechanisms, or damaged cylinders. We repair or fit new locks to your specifications, same day if needed.

services.title: Burglary Repairs
services.desc: After a break-in? We secure your property immediately with emergency boarding and lock replacement, then advise on upgrades.

services.title: Lock Upgrades & Security
services.desc: Improve your home or business security with modern anti-snap cylinders, deadbolts, and multi-point locks. Expert fitting included.

services.title: Vehicle Unlock
services.desc: Keys locked in your car or van? Non-destructive entry available. Fast response to get you mobile again.

services.title: Key Cutting & Duplication
services.desc: Spare keys cut on the spot using our mobile cutting equipment. Perfect for new properties or lost master keys.

about_pullquote: I started this business because nobody was answering their phone at 2am when people really needed help.
about_para_1: Derby Locksmith & Security has been serving Nottingham and the surrounding areas for over 15 years. We built the business on one principle: when you're locked out, the last thing you need is a slow response or a technician who's learning on the job. Every member of our team has years of hands-on experience, and we invest in the latest non-destructive entry tools so we can get you back in without damage to your property.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on availability and honesty. We operate 24 hours a day, 365 days a year, because emergencies don't stick to office hours. Customers come back to us because we turn up when we say we will, we fix the problem right the first time, and we charge fair prices with no hidden fees. Word-of-mouth recommendations from satisfied homeowners and businesses make up the bulk of our work.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Sunday evening and didn't know what to do. Called Derby Locksmith and they were here in 25 minutes. Really professional, got me back in without any damage, and the price was exactly what they quoted over the phone. Couldn't ask for better service.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a burglary last month and they came out the same night to board up and fit new locks. The team was brilliant during a stressful time. Now I feel secure again. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Rachel H.

reviews.text: Used them three times now for various jobs — emergency lockout, new bathroom lock, and spare keys. Always reliable, honest about what needs doing, and fair prices. Best local locksmith I've used.
reviews.author: David K.
